text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day in late December. Admire Vega was 
staring with exceptional intensity at a 
newly arrived racing magazine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The special feature is, of course, on the 
looming year-end Grand Prix: the Umamusume 
competing in the "Arima Kinen."
choice_data_list: Ah, that reminds me—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list:
So you were picked to race, Narita Top 
Road.

You were picked to race, huh, Narita Top 
Road.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Well, she's always been popular, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega's fingertips slowly trace the 
text of the interview.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for choosing me." "—I will 
definitely live up to your expectations!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gazing at the photo of Narita Top Road 
smiling with dazzling freshness, she 
seemed to narrow her eyes just a fraction.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to when we first met, her 
expression has softened beyond 
recognition..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her as she approaches a major 
milestone—three years since her debut—I 
ponder. Conveniently, Christmas is right 
around the corner, so—
choice_data_list:
(I want to give her something to show my 
appreciation.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I took a look around at various 
things by myself for the time being, 
but...
choice_data_list: (Hmm, I can't decide...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I really want to give something that will 
genuinely make them happy, but to do that, 
I need a few more hints to help point me 
in the right direction."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Perhaps because I was agonizing over it, 
'she' stood out to me so vividly.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wah!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my~, if it isn't Ayabe-san's 
Trainer!
choice_data_list: Curren-chan! Perfect timing...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her roommate in the dorms, she might 
know something about what Admire Vega 
needs!
choice_data_list:
There's something I'd like to talk to you 
about...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah... Umm.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sorry about that~♪
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren is in a bit of a rush right now! So 
sooorry~!
choice_data_list:
O-Oh, I see. Sorry for bringing this up so 
suddenly.

O-Oh, I see. Sorry for springing this on 
you so suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, after hanging my head in 
disappointment and returning home 
empty-handed...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...And so, ——... That's why, ~~~...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I see, ...—is, ...—at—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!! In that case, —if... is... 
then—
choice_data_list: (It's everyone's rivals...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe this time, I can actually hear 
something meaningful. Steeling my resolve, 
I go over to talk to her, but—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...! ...!?!?!? W-W-W-W-What— 
A-A-A-Ayabe-san's Trainer?!
choice_data_list:
Sorry to spring this on you out of 
nowhere! There was just something I wanted 
to ask—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! ...Retreat!!
choice_data_list: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah! Ahhh... No, but, ummm...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me! Coming through, pardon me!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I will~~~~!!
choice_data_list: Eeeh...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, I couldn't get a chance to 
talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I never thought everyone close to Admire 
Vega would blatantly avoid me like this... 
Did I do something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should reconsider how I conduct 
myself a bit... While lost in such 
thoughts——

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Christmas Day has already arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After much agonizing, I decided on a soft 
sports towel as a present, but I wonder if 
it might be a bit too plain for a 
Christmas gift.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to at least help back her up, I 
did my best decorating the room and such, 
but I'm not really sure if it will 
actually benefit her...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Good evening.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, while I was agonizing over such 
pointless things, Admire Vega arrived."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Holding a small gift in those hands—
choice_data_list: ...Wait, huh? What!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Also, sorry, but let me lodge a protest.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Why are you trying to prepare a gift 
too?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are, Ayabe-san!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Curren-san...? What is it, what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Umm, for now, let's hurry up and get away 
from here! Ayabe-san's Trainer is coming 
right this way!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, quite a shocker, isn't it~! Plus, I 
bet she's here for the exact same thing 
Ayabe-san is.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The exact same thing: "hunting for 
Christmas presents"!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No way... Why is that person here?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, let's think about that later and 
get out before we pass out!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It'd ruin the fun if your present got 
spoiled, right, Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ayabe-san, Ayabe-san! Let's get out of 
here quick! Trainer-san is over there...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, excuse me, I-I think she came over 
here to look for a present for Ayabe-san 
too, though...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (...So then, why?!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...If I receive something, I want to give 
back. Just as much as I was given, fair 
and square.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I like to think I understand just how much 
you've done for me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Because I've learned to truly look at 
'myself'. That's how I was able to 
understand that, too."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Trained me thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: She watched over me with every race.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You followed me down my path.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I hesitated, she gave me a push 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...That's why I wanted to repay you. I 
asked around and everything to pick out a 
gift, but..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If I receive one from you as well, it will 
disrupt the balance. ...That would trouble 
me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is that strong sense of duty of hers 
something she gained from constantly 
feeling indebted to a younger sister who 
was never even there, and spending her 
life trying to repay that debt—?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that thought idly floating in the 
back of my mind, I slowly shook my head.
choice_data_list:
There's not a single thing for you to 
worry about.

There's not a single thing for you to 
worry about.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Why?
choice_data_list: Because you've given me so much too
Because I've received so much too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I... haven't given you anything.
choice_data_list:
I got to see so many of them running so 
energetically.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That is—
choice_data_list: You let me help with your dream

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No, that's why... ngh.
choice_data_list: I'm honored I got to be your trainer!
You let me stay on as your trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega finally fell silent, and after 
letting out a long, long, deep sigh, she 
spoke.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I've been thinking about this for a 
long time, but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I really can't figure you out sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Inside the package from Admire Vega was a 
simple, dark blue fountain pen.
choice_data_list: It's colored like the night. I like it.
It's colored like the night. I like it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...That's true.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: With that in mind, I bought it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: With that in mind, I bought it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And although it unexpectedly turned into a 
gift exchange, Admire Vega accepted my 
present, but—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Are these... towels inside?
choice_data_list: Sorry it was kind of a bland choice.
Sorry it was kind of a bland choice.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I don't really mind, honestly...
choice_data_list:
I did at least put a lot of thought into 
how it feels to the touch...!

I did at least pay attention to how it 
feels to the touch...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...If you do that, I feel like it'll 
throw you off balance after all."
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ............Because I love it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Fluffy things. ...I like them.
